text:
jessica_marketing: Quick pulse — webinar Thurs 9am PT. We need a fast CPC-sprint: compress creative pool + rebalance retarget. Proposal:
- reduce creatives to top 3 (headlines + 1 long-form)
- search CPC cap $2 max, start 2am PT Wed
- retarget window 7d -> 30d, but for webinar push make retarget spend 30% of budget in 48h before
- update UTM utm_campaign=webinar_may, route leads to SDR queue 'webinar-intent'
Can we ship this today? :timer_clock:

ryan_growth: +1 to compress. Can we keep a control creative set (2% traffic) for benchmark narrative? Need one baseline to compare CPAs. Also please add a UTMs sheet — I want traffic source + creative variant mapped.

marta_paid: I can roll creative switch at 10:15am. I'll keep one long-form video as the holdout control. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-webinar-utms (I'll update names to wk-webinar-3c). Will auto-pause low performers (<0.8 conv rate). :rocket:

devin_ops: Ops is good with the plan. I'll raise the retarget pool cap and add a pacing guardrail. Temporary rule: if account spend pace >110% target for 30m, throttle to balanced mode and notify #paid-alerts.

jessica_marketing: Perfect. Ryan — confirm the benchmark metrics you want (CPA, CTR, lead quality) and Marta — ping when switch is live. I'll update lead routing to tag 'webinar-high-intent' and forward to SDRs via Zapier.

ryan_growth: KPI list: CPA, CPL, #SQLs from webinar signups, and 3-day demo retention. Benchmarks: CPA < $35 for search, CPL < $20 for retarget. Keep the control at ~2% traffic for clear lift. :thumbsup:

marta_paid: switching now. Live in ~5m. posting config snippet for ops and tracking:
```
campaign: webinar_may
search_cpc_cap: 2.00
retarget_budget_pct: 30
retarget_window_days: 30
creative_pool: ['hero_a','hero_b','long_video']
control_split: 2%
utm_template: ?utm_source={{source}}&utm_medium={{medium}}&utm_campaign=webinar_may&creative={{variant}}
```

deploy-bot: Campaign updates scheduled: webinar_may changes queued by marta_paid. ETA deploy 10:20am.

devin_ops: Deploy looks good from infra side, monitoring pacing and errors. If spend >=120% in any 30m window, auto-throttle and post alert here.

jessica_marketing: Thanks team — I'll draft a 1-pager for comms + benchmark narrative after first 12h of data. If anything spikes, call it out here and we'll rollback creatives. 🚀
